steps.instruction: Make a magic ring, chain 2, work 12 double crochet stitches into the ring. Join with slip stitch to first dc.
Chain 2, work 2 double crochet in each stitch around (24 stitches). Join with sl st.
Chain 2, *1 double crochet in next st, 2 double crochet in next st*, repeat from * around (36 stitches). Join.
Chain 2, work 1 double crochet in each stitch around to establish height. Fasten off and weave in ends.
